body: ARENA_NODE_COUNT 2->5, ARENA_HALF_EXTENT 12->20, new Arathi-style 5-node layout (two flanking each spawn + one contested center). Jungle creeps scale automatically. Generalized Courier's W teleport from a hardcoded 2-node assumption to farthest-of-N. Found and fixed a real test-environment collision: the new center node at (0,0) coincided with an unrelated test's hero position, causing a jungle creep to deal damage the test misattributed to bot AI. Verified via full build/test suite + mingw cross-compile. Commit 8b9aee5.
title: Arena map expanded to Arathi Basin size, 5 capture nodes (S170-119)
